page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with Hebrew and Syriac entries. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Signature "Ddd" at foot. No margin notes.

main_text.p: עָבַר Ch.& Syr. Facere, conficere, efficere, operari, Colere terrā, agere, peragere, parare, apparare. Pehil Syr. ܥܒܕ Affectus, ܥܒܕ Male afficitur, affectus, Matt.17.15. Plur. ܥܒܕܝܢ? ܥܒܕܝܢ Qui pessimè affecti sunt, Matth.4.4. Ithp. mutare transire, in vel subire, transmutare: Mutari, transfigurari, Ex Aphel Præter. fœm. Syr. ܐܬܥܒܪ Fieri. Ex Aphel Præter. fœm. Syr. ܐܥܒܕ Fecit, 2.ad Cor.7.11.
ܥܒܕܐ Syr. Factor, Conditor. Plural. cum Affix. ܥܒܕܘܗܝ Factores ejus, ad Rom.2.13.
עוֹבְדָא Ch. ܥܒܕܐ Syr.Opus,factum: Item Operis merces,Psal.109.20. Plur. עוֹבְדֵי, Syr. ܥܒܕܝ. Fœmin. עוֹבְדְתָּא Gen.33.14.
מַעְבַּד Ch.Idem. Plur. מַעְבָּדִין. Syr. ܡܥܒܕܐ Opus erat ei, Oportebat eum, Johan.4.4.
ܥܒܕܐ Syr. Factor, effector, operator. Fœmin. ܥܒܕܬܐ Effectrix, operatrix, ad Rom.4.15.
ܥܒܕܘܬܐ Syr. Operatio, efficacia, efficacitas. Ch. מַעְבְּרוּתָא דִסִימְתָא Opus thesaurorum, Prov.21.6.
עַבְרָא עַבְדָא Ch.& Syr.Servus. Plur. עַבְרִיָא, עַבְדִין.

page.notes: Several Syriac and Hebrew entries are only partly legible in the scan; the vocalised forms are transcribed as best read and may contain errors. Marginal show-through from the reverse page was disregarded.
